Abdul Rehman v. Province of Sindh

Order

This constitutional petition under Article 199 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973 assails the order of the Service Tribunal dated 02.08.2019 whereby the petitioner's departmental appeal against reversion was dismissed for non-prosecution.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, we are of the view that dismissal for non-prosecution without adjudication on merits defeats the right of access to justice. The matter is remanded to the Tribunal for decision afresh within ninety days.

The petition is disposed of in the above terms along with the listed application.
